# Support

For help with Nyastra's Mod Manager:

- **[Documentation](../docs/README.md)** for setup and development guides.
- **[Linux installation and profile import](../docs/packaging/linux.md#install-and-profile-import)**
  for package installation and importing an existing Linux Vortex profile.
- **[Discord](https://discord.com/invite/TQJrbZcgKF)** for setup and usage questions.
- **[GitHub issues](https://github.com/CateDesu/Nyastra-Mod-Manager/issues)**
  for reproducible bugs and feature requests.

This is an experimental Linux preview. Include your distribution, package
version, game and extension versions, and steps to reproduce the problem when
asking for help. Review logs before sharing them.

Please do not report suspected security vulnerabilities publicly.
